title: Strings & Indexing: The Matrix
description: Manipulate the fabric of text itself. Learn to target specific characters, slice data streams, and format output like a pro.

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Index Origin
exercises.description: In Python, what is the index of the first character in a string?

exercises.title: Clearance Check: Negative Indexing
exercises.description: What does index `[-1]` refer to in a string?

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Concatenation
exercises.description: Combine 'Cyber' and 'Punk' with a plus sign.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: F-String
exercises.description: Use an f-string to insert the variable 'name'.
exercises.targetCode: print(f"Agent {name}, your mission directives are ready for final review.")

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Slicing
exercises.description: Slice the first 3 characters of the string 'code'.
exercises.targetCode: sector_prefix = sector_id[0:5] # Extracting sector designator from full ID

exercises.title: System Repair: Index Error
exercises.description: The string 'Python' has 6 characters. Attempting to access index 6 causes a crash.

exercises.title: System Repair: F-String Syntax
exercises.description: The variables aren't being replaced because the 'f' is missing.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Initials Extractor
exercises.description: Extract and print the first letter of `first_name` and `last_name`.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Reverse Cipher
exercises.description: Given `code = 'SECRET'`, print it in reverse using slicing.

exercises.title: Field Mission: Username Generator
exercises.description: Create a username: First 3 letters of name + year. Print it.
exercises.solution:
name = "Anderson"
year = 1999
username = name[0:3] + str(year)
print(username)

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Message Encryption
exercises.description: Combine codename and secret key to create encrypted identity tag.

exercises.title: Neural Sync: Intel Report Formatter
exercises.description: Professional intelligence report using f-strings with multiple variables.
exercises.targetCode:
# Operation Status Report
target = "Volkov"
location = "Moscow"
status = "Tracked"
report = f"TARGET: {target} | LOCATION: {location} | STATUS: {status}"
print(report)

exercises.title: Debug Challenge: Index Out of Range
exercises.description: CRITICAL: Accessing character beyond message length! Message has 5 chars but trying to access index 5 (6th position). Fix before system crash!

exercises.title: Ciphers: Call Sign Extractor
exercises.description: Extract first 3 letters of codename "PHANTOM" to create shortened call sign. Print the abbreviated version.

exercises.title: Decryption: Message Reversal
exercises.description: Enemy uses simple reverse cipher. Decrypt intercepted message "REDRUM" by reversing the string using slicing [::-1].

exercises.title: Field Intel: Coordinate Formatter
exercises.description: Format GPS coordinates for field operative. Combine latitude "40.7128" and longitude "-74.0060" with f-string. Format: 'Coordinates: LAT, LON'

exercises.title: Boss Challenge: Codename Generator
exercises.description: CLASSIFIED: Generate operative codename from real identity. Take first 3 letters of first_name 'Alexander', last 2 of last_name 'Pierce', add birth_year '1975'. Format: first3 + last2 + year (e.g., 'Alece1975'). Use slicing and concatenation!
exercises.starterCode:
# Generate covert identity
first_name = "Alexander"
last_name = "Pierce"
birth_year = "1975"
# Build codename
exercises.solution:
first_name = "Alexander"
last_name = "Pierce"
birth_year = "1975"
codename = first_name[0:3] + last_name[-2:] + birth_year
print(codename)
